chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you are in a state where you can find nothing but clay, then perform Tayammum with it, for Allah is more deserving of excusing you, if there is not with you a dry garment or a brick which you are able to break and perform Tayammum with it. And in another report: 'Soil is good and water is a purifier'.

key_terms.لِبْد: A type of thick woolen fabric or brick-like earth

ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for Tayammum when water is not available?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific material requirements for Tayammum, establishing that any available earth or clay suffices when water is inaccessible, thereby highlighting the principle of divine leniency (al-'udhr). It further distinguishes the purity of the soil itself, noting in an alternative narration that the earth is inherently 'pure' (tayyib), which supports the Shia view of the intrinsic cleanliness of natural earth elements. This ruling underscores the practical flexibility in ritual purification, ensuring worship remains accessible even in extreme scarcity.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When you were is a situation not being able upon except for the clay, so perform Tayammum with it, for Allahazwj is the Highest for the Excusing, when there does not happen to be dry clothes with you, or a brick to be able to break it and perform Tayammum with it’. And in another report, ‘Soil is good and water is a purifier’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘In a condition where you cannot find anything other than clay, take Tayammum with it; Allah accepts one’s inabilities. So also is the case if you do not have any dry clothes or bricks from which dust can be collected for Tayammum.’”
In another Hadith it is said that soil is fine and water is purifying.”
